name: Browbeat
oracle_text: Any player may have Browbeat deal 5 damage to them. If no one does, target player draws three cards.
flavor_text:
"Even the threat of power has power."
—Jeska, warrior adept

name: Unravel
oracle_text: Counter target spell. If the amount of mana spent to cast that spell was less than its mana value, you draw a card.
flavor_text: Drix weftwalking requires neither eternity columns nor Pinnacle codebooks. But the art is ancient, and each passing is a leap of faith.

name: Simulacrum
oracle_text: You gain life equal to the damage dealt to you this turn. Simulacrum deals damage to target creature you control equal to the damage dealt to you this turn.

name: Jaded Response
oracle_text: Counter target spell if it shares a color with a creature you control.
flavor_text:
"Calm down everyone; it's nothing we haven't seen before."
—Sisay

name: Anoint with Affliction
oracle_text:
Exile target creature if it has mana value 3 or less.
Corrupted — Exile that creature instead if its controller has three or more poison counters.
flavor_text: Many vatkeepers use necrogen etchings to judge the value of their aspirants. If the wounds rot and fester, the recipient is not worth further effort.

name: Fade from History
oracle_text: Each player who controls an artifact or enchantment creates a 2/2 green Bear creature token. Then destroy all artifacts and enchantments.
flavor_text: After a long hibernation, Argoth began slowly recovering from the ravages of war.

name: Insatiable Appetite
oracle_text: You may sacrifice a Food. If you do, target creature gets +5/+5 until end of turn. Otherwise, that creature gets +3/+3 until end of turn.
flavor_text: He ate them out of house and home and shed and barn and flock and herd.

name: Inquisitor's Snare
oracle_text: Prevent all damage target attacking or blocking creature would deal this turn. If that creature is black or red, destroy it.
flavor_text: Driven by their paranoia, kithkin inflict on their foes all the agonies they believe would have been inflicted on them.

name: Resolute Strike
oracle_text: Target creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn. If it's a Warrior, you may attach an Equipment you control to it.
flavor_text:
"If you practice something often enough, it becomes part of you. That's why we train, and that's why we survive."
—Tasha, Graypelt veteran

name: Bring the Ending
oracle_text:
Counter target spell unless its controller pays {2}.
Corrupted — Counter that spell instead if its controller has three or more poison counters.
flavor_text: Kaya watched in horror as the illusion vanished from her hands. Jace held the real Sylex—and had activated it before phyresis claimed his mind.

name: Disorder
oracle_text: Disorder deals 2 damage to each white creature and each player who controls a white creature.
flavor_text:
"Fire hurts them almost as much as the chaos that follows. Almost."
—The Western Paladin

name: Roiling Terrain
oracle_text: Destroy target land, then Roiling Terrain deals damage to that land's controller equal to the number of land cards in that player's graveyard.
flavor_text:
"The trembling lands ruptured, leaving an open door for things from below to emerge."
—Screed of the Mul Daya

name: Dismantle
oracle_text: Destroy target artifact. If that artifact had counters on it, put that many +1/+1 counters or charge counters on an artifact you control.
flavor_text:
"If only the living were so easily salvaged."
—Memnarch

name: Reign of Terror
oracle_text: Destroy all green creatures or all white creatures. They can't be regenerated. You lose 2 life for each creature that died this way.
flavor_text:
"I don't know what takes them; they die around me without time to scream."
—Scout Ekemet, final journal

name: Teachings of the Archaics
oracle_text: If an opponent has more cards in hand than you, draw two cards. Draw three cards instead if an opponent has at least four more cards in hand than you.
flavor_text: Mages seek out the ancient beings known as the Archaics for their boundless knowledge of history and magic, dispensed only in cryptic metaphors.

name: Twinstrike
oracle_text:
Twinstrike deals 2 damage to each of two target creatures.
Hellbent — Destroy those creatures instead if you have no cards in hand.
flavor_text: They're dying left and right.

name: Necrotic Fumes
oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, exile a creature you control.
Exile target creature or planeswalker.
flavor_text: When live specimens aren't readily available, Witherbloom mages make creative use of ragged spirits clinging to long-dead bodies.

name: Match the Odds
oracle_text: Create a 1/1 white Ally creature token. Put a +1/+1 counter on it for each creature your opponents control.
flavor_text:
"Here's your chance, Earthbenders! Take it! Your fate is in your own hands!"
—Katara

name: Lightning Dart
oracle_text: Lightning Dart deals 1 damage to target creature. If that creature is white or blue, Lightning Dart deals 4 damage to it instead.
flavor_text: Broken and punctured by dozens of Phyrexian portals, the angry sky began to spit lightning back at the world.

name: Reward the Faithful
oracle_text: Any number of target players each gain life equal to the greatest mana value among permanents you control.
flavor_text: "When you have drunk your fill, pass the cup to others who thirst."

name: Bane's Contingency
oracle_text: Counter target spell. If that spell targets a commander you control, instead counter that spell, scry 2, then draw a card.
set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
flavor_text: "My whims dictate the fate of nations. Your pitiful mortal magic is no more significant than a gnat buzzing in my ear."

name: Engulf the Shore
oracle_text: Return to their owners' hands all creatures with toughness less than or equal to the number of Islands you control.
flavor_text:
"The tides have begun to ignore the moon."
—Tamiyo's journal

name: Spoils of Evil
oracle_text: For each artifact or creature card in target opponent's graveyard, add {C} and you gain 1 life.
flavor_text:
"Virtue has its rewards, as does its opposite."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

name: Thoughtweft Charge
oracle_text: Target creature gets +3/+3 until end of turn. If a creature entered the battlefield under your control this turn, draw a card.
flavor_text: United in mind, soul, and muscle.

name: Dispersal Shield
oracle_text: Counter target spell if its mana value is less than or equal to the greatest mana value among permanents you control.
flavor_text: "Maybe next time."

name: Lich-Knights' Conquest
oracle_text: Sacrifice any number of artifacts, enchantments, and/or tokens. Return that many creature cards from your graveyard to the battlefield.
flavor_text: In their rotting minds, they still quest for virtue and glory.

name: Coordinated Clobbering
oracle_text: Tap one or two target untapped creatures you control. They each deal damage equal to their power to target creature an opponent controls.
flavor_text: Zimone's theory was that the fractalization of atmospheric aether would increase kinetic energy. Tyvar's theory was that if you hit cultists in the face really hard, they would fall down. They were both right.

name: Crater's Claws
oracle_text:
Crater's Claws deals X damage to any target.
Ferocious — Crater's Claws deals X plus 2 damage instead if you control a creature with power 4 or greater.

name: Battlefield Improvisation
oracle_text: Target creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn. If that creature is attacking, you may attach any number of Equipment you control to it.
flavor_text: The fallen had no more need of their weapons, but the living could still make use of them.

name: Pippin's Bravery
oracle_text: You may sacrifice a Food. If you do, target creature gets +4/+4 until end of turn. Otherwise, that creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
flavor_text: Pippin stabbed upwards, and the written blade of Westernesse pierced through the hide and went deep into the vitals of the troll.

name: Ill-Gotten Gains
oracle_text: Exile Ill-Gotten Gains. Each player discards their hand, then returns up to three cards from their graveyard to their hand.
flavor_text: Urza thought it a crusade. Xantcha knew it was a robbery.

name: Audience with Trostani
oracle_text: Create a 0/1 green Plant creature token, then draw cards equal to the number of differently named creature tokens you control.
flavor_text: Trostani was as regal and vibrant as ever, but Kaya couldn't shake the sense that there was something off, some discordant note lurking deep within the chorus.

name: Rupture
oracle_text: Sacrifice a creature. Rupture deals damage equal to that creature's power to each creature without flying and each player.
flavor_text: All creatures have an inner fire. Releasing it can be dangerous.

name: Hour of Glory
oracle_text: Exile target creature. If that creature was a God, its controller reveals their hand and exiles all cards from it with the same name as that creature.
flavor_text: The gods of the trials also faced the opportunity to prove themselves worthy.

name: Seeds of Innocence
oracle_text: Destroy all artifacts. They can't be regenerated. The controller of each of those artifacts gains life equal to its mana value.
flavor_text:
"I have hidden from the machinations of Zhalfir for centuries. Why should I join *your* campaign?"
—Jolrael

name: Vow to Erebor
oracle_text: Untap target creature you control. It gets +2/+2 until end of turn. If it's a Dwarf, you may attach an Equipment you control to it.
flavor_text:
"We shall soon, before the break of day, start on our long journey—a journey from which some of us, or perhaps all of us, may never return."
—Thorin

name: Unified Will
oracle_text: Counter target spell if you control more creatures than that spell's controller.
flavor_text:
"We're glad to be of service—to be an audience to your failure."
—Maizah Shere, Tazeem lullmage

name: Unforge
oracle_text: Destroy target Equipment. If that Equipment was attached to a creature, Unforge deals 2 damage to that creature.
flavor_text: Compared to the fire of the forge, the strength of steel is nothing.

name: Truce
oracle_text: Each player may draw up to two cards. For each card less than two a player draws this way, that player gains 2 life.
flavor_text:
Not all victories require defeat.
—Onean idiom

name: Temporary Truce
oracle_text: Each player may draw up to two cards. For each card less than two a player draws this way, that player gains 2 life.
